# Team Web loop fixtures (WS-044)

Interactive fixtures for the Inspector Team Web collaboration loop.
These are not static HTML prototypes: the Inspector demo/live team routes
load them as server facts and exercise login, overview, card/list toggle,
blocker drill-down, collaboration writes (idempotent receipts), reconnect,
expired ops, and double-submit guards.

Schema: `awr-team-web-loop-fixture/v1`
